title: Barista Host API Event
description: Payload of a Server-Sent Event on a session event stream. The SSE `id` field carries the cursor; reconnect with Last-Event-ID to resume without gaps or duplicates.

cursor.description: Stable, monotonic, opaque cursor. Equals the SSE id field.

type.description: The closed vocabulary a client may switch on. A provider's node-observed lifecycle events are translated into these names; a provider-internal event type is never published here, so a client that switches on this field never sees a name that belongs to one implementation.

data.description: Type-specific payload. Byte streams (exec.stdout/stderr) carry base64 in `data.chunk`.
